### 5.2.1 Combining both data frame by using left join



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

  select(1:4, 7, 15)
```

## 5.3 Global Measures of Spatial Association

Step 1: Deriving Queen's contiguity weights: sfdep methods



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wm_q <- hunan %>%
  mutate(nb = st_contiguity(geometry),
         wt = st_weights(
           nb, style = "W"),
         .before = 1) 
```
:::



## 5.4 Performing Global Moran' I permutation teat



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1234)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
global_moran_perm(wm_q$GDPPC,
             wm_q$nb,
             wm_q$wt,
             nsim = 99)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```

weights: listw

alternative hypothesis: two.sided
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
lisa <- wm_q %>% 
  mutate(local_moran = local_moran(
    GDPPC, nb, wt, nsim = 99),
         .before = 1) %>%
  unnest(local_moran)
```
